observations: Standing fan with a circular metal grille and three blades.
Brand 'OX' is visible on a red oval sticker on the center of the grille in photo 0.
The fan has a greenish-grey metal pole and a four-legged cross-base.
A black power cord is visible on the ground.
The fan is positioned outdoors on a concrete surface against a dark wall.

risks.risk: The oscillation mechanism may be broken.
risks.proof: A video showing the fan head swiveling.

risks.risk: The oscillation motor may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the oscillation motor spinning.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the fan powered on and oscillating.
Photo of the manufacturer's label/plate usually found on the back or bottom of the motor housing.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
